title: BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier with AUC Refit
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments with a regex, truncates to 200 tokens, and builds a training-only vocabulary of up to 120,000 tokens occurring at least twice; other tokens map to UNK. A word-embedding model applies spatial dropout, two bidirectional LSTMs, masked average and max pooling, then two residual ReLU dense layers and a scalar toxicity logit. It trains for two epochs on continuous training targets using BCE-with-logits, Adam, mixed-precision CUDA training, gradient clipping, linearly decayed learning rate, and shuffled length-bucketed batches. It then refits the classifier and encoder using sampled identity/toxicity strata. This objective maximizes a differentiable pairwise-AUC composite comprising overall, subgroup, BPSN, and BNSP terms with a negative-power aggregation, while retaining a weighted BCE anchor. Inference batches by length and returns sigmoid probabilities; validation probabilities are evaluated and saved with the model.
